d: Using daring acrobatics, Cirque du Soleil creates a visually striking world to tell a story about the freedom to choose and the thrill of blazing one's own trail, inspired by the culture of action sports.
The captain of an aeroplane carrying some VIP passengers has to deal with a mysterious hijacker, who demands a ransom and seemingly vanishes into thin air before the plane lands.
At the height of her fame, Myra, a fashion model, is suddenly out of favour with her agency and deserted by her boyfriend, but she sees an opportunity to win him back years later.
A wife embarks on the path to disaster when the seeds of jealousy are planted in her mind after overhearing a woman and a man with the same name as her husband discussing a trip to Paris.

Wanting to prove their safes are impregnable, a company challenges ex-safe-breaker Sam to crack one for a cash prize as a publicity stunt, and the retired thief is determined to get his money's worth.
Ten years after he was a young soldier billeted in Paris at the end of World War Two, Robert Simpson returns to the house where he stayed, owned by resistance hero Hector Vareille.
Everything's coming up roses for newlyweds (Patrick O'Neal, Kathie Brown) using the garden as a graveyard for blackmailers.
An ethical lawyer becomes very disturbed about what to do when the client he just got acquitted of murder brags that he committed the crime.

d: Jordan Davis, Hudson Westbrook, Graham Barham, Avery Anna and Emily Ann Roberts bring live country music to the Grand Ole Opry stage.
